items.summary: Reject all new implementation admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, measurement debt and failed requests remain unresolved, and revenue, ROI, margin, attribution, and causal lift are unsupported. Preserve only the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case: CTO must record root cause or justified closure, deterministic tests, isolated validation, build evidence, rollback, release/security boundaries, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence by 2026-10-01T09:00Z, then release one slot or escalate to the owner. After capacity and site-overlap clearance, admit at most the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement; do not create duplicate work. Candidate implementations for rodhat.com, complicated.work, and deadlymaracas.com remain unqueued pending the same CTO slot release; scaffold work additionally requires verified launch-readiness evidence before admission. Keep private launch and security gates unchanged.
